Gold and Silver Prices Decline to Year-Low Amid Interest Rate Hike Fears

Gold and silver prices have fallen to their lowest levels in a year, with a notable decline observed across major cities on November 18. This price drop is attributed to fears of expected interest rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve, which are weighing on the precious metals market. Analysts are watching key price levels as the market navigates these concerns.
